delta.partial_json: duces a type alias for g

units.summary: Adds an optional onStatus callback to statusRecorder, fired when the final status is written.
units.headline: statusRecorder gains onStatus callback field
units.reason: Field is inert alone; behavior is in WriteHeader and serveThroughBreaker.

units.summary: WriteHeader now invokes onStatus with the final status (>=200 or 101) before forwarding the header, enabling early breaker outcome reporting.
units.headline: WriteHeader fires onStatus callback on final status
units.reason: Changes when breaker outcomes are recorded, in the request path.
focus: Callback runs before the header reaches the client; it must not panic or block
Multiple WriteHeader calls: only the once-guard stops double reporting

units.summary: Introduces a type alias for gobreaker's two-step breaker used across the router.
units.headline: Add groupBreaker alias for two-step breaker
units.reason: Type alias; behavior arises from constructor and call sites.

units.summary: Constructor now builds a TwoStepCircuitBreaker with the same settings.
units.headline: newGroupBreaker returns a two-step breaker
units.reason: Changes the breaker type and the way outcomes are reported.
focus: Settings (IsExcluded, ReadyToTrip) behave the same with two-step API

units.summary: Replaces cb.Execute with Allow/done so the outcome is reported when the response status is written (or on return/panic), via a once-guard. This frees half-open trial slots during long watches.
units.headline: Breaker outcome reported at status write, not handler return
units.reason: Core circuit-breaker accounting and panic handling changed.
focus: Every path calls done exactly once, including panics and handlers that never write a header
Status-time outcome ignores later body failures, accepted by design
Re-panic preserves http.ErrAbortHandler behavior; an abort before status is counted as a failure

units.summary: Test helper signature updated to the groupBreaker type.
units.headline: Test helper takes groupBreaker type
units.reason: Test-only type update.

units.summary: Test constructs a two-step breaker instead of a regular one.
units.headline: Test uses two-step breaker constructor
units.reason: Test-only adaptation to the new type.

units.summary: tripBreaker uses Allow/done to record a forced failure instead of Execute.
units.headline: tripBreaker uses Allow and done
units.reason: Test helper adapted to two-step API.
